title: Odyssey Guest Lecture 2027
objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 114 attendees for this Guest Lecture, in line with turnout at our previous Guest Lecture events.
The requested budget of INR 14,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Guest Lecture.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
